functions.residue: RESIDUE SHAPE 228 0x1c mov r1, #0 | str r0, [sp]; 0x20 str r0, [sp] | mov r1, #0; 0x28 str r1, [sp, #4] | mov r2, r5
functions.description: pick random slot reward ids and values
functions.notes: Size matches (0x48c) and code shape matches; 228 bytes differ, all register allocation. Target has entries=sb key=r8 out=r7 ctx=fp elem=r6 p=r5 tier=r4; mine has entries=r6 key=r5 out=r4 elem=r7 tier=r8 p=sb. Declaration order and colorsweep did not fix it. Levers that closed shape: sum read into a separate int so bitfield loads are reloaded after rand(); roll unsigned; range = max-min as its own int; entries[idx].pick[i] re-indexed in each pick (idx is address-taken); three unrolled pick blocks falling through to the common tail; while (excess>0) not do-while; Trio id/val copies on stack (2 raw struct-pointer casts) for the tier-3 permutation; locals ids/vals declared before idx so idx lands at sp+4. colorsweep suggested 'r += 1' split, not adopted.
